text: Morning! Bodo Beam. If you can build it, I’ve got it. If you can’t, I’ve got it too.
Aisle seven has gone missing, by the way. I’ve been looking since Tuesday.
Planks, nails, iron, sticks. Honest goods. None of it flashes.
Take two more nails than you calculated. Always. That’s not a sales pitch, that’s physics.
Blueprints I have. The building happens at YOUR place — at the workbench, with your own thumbs.
It’s all on there: materials, order of work, and at the bottom „stay calm“.
Advice! Gladly. So: you need more planks than you think and less tooling than you want.
And if it wobbles, give it one whack. If it still wobbles, it was intentional.
Looking is building too. Just slower.
I’ll be back with the screws if you find aisle seven.
